instruction: Check the desktop document for plugin recommendations and install at least 4 extensions from the list to Chrome.

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing at least 4 extensions from the recommended list in the desktop document. Custom getter reads the .docx file to extract recommended extension names. Custom metric compares installed extensions against recommended list and verifies at least 4 match.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies ALL instruction requirements: (1) reads recommended extensions from desktop document via get_recommended_extensions_from_docx__4329ad6c, (2) checks installed extensions via find_installed_extension_name, (3) verifies at least 4 installed extensions match the recommended list
Getter 'get_recommended_extensions_from_docx__4329ad6c' correctly extracts extension names from .docx file by parsing it as ZIP and reading word/document.xml (chrome.py:110-133)
Getter 'get_combine_results' correctly combines results from multiple getters into single dict with 'installed' and 'recommended' keys (chrome.py:28-64)

Metric 'check_extension_count__4329ad6c' correctly handles result dict format, performs case-insensitive matching between installed and recommended lists (chrome.py:54-58), counts matches, and returns 1.0 if matching_count >= min_count
Parameter handling is CORRECT: Line 43 directly accesses expected.get('min_count', 0) - no incorrect patterns like expected.get('rules') found
Postconfig correctly opens chrome://extensions/ to ensure extensions page is visible for verification
Complete coverage: all three instruction requirements are semantically verified by the evaluator logic
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: OPTIONAL: Remove redundant type check at chrome.py:42-45 (isinstance(expected, dict)) - when expected.type='rule', expected will always be a dict
OPTIONAL: Review skip filter at chrome.py:132 - might be too aggressive if extension names contain words like 'recommended' or 'plugin'
